title: The Moonstone Jewellery House
teaser: The display case was opened with its own key, and the most expensive set was left untouched. What's missing are the designs for a new necklace, and master jeweller Eidelman is dead. The police think two people did it: one kept everyone busy, the other knew exactly where everything was kept.

habits.label: Plaster on a finger
habits.habit: A sticking plaster on the index finger
clues: The glass of a showroom case has a fingerprint with the neat strip of a plaster across it. The culprit has a plaster on their finger.
A crumpled bit of plaster with a drop of blood on it lies by the workbench. The culprit has a bandaged finger.

habits.label: Scar on the lip
habits.habit: A scar across the upper lip
clues: People in the showroom remember a face with a scar across the upper lip by the display case at half past seven. The culprit has a scar on their lip.
The office window looks onto the back door, and the clerk swears someone with a scar across the lip was standing there. The culprit has a scar on their lip.

habits.label: Smells of sealing wax
clues: There are crumbs of red sealing wax on the desk in the owner's study, though no letters were sealed today. The culprit's fingers smell of sealing wax.
The empty folder that held the necklace designs smells of fresh sealing wax. The culprit's fingers smell of sealing wax.

habits.label: Officer's map case
habits.habit: A leather map case over the shoulder
clues: A buckle torn off the strap of an officer's map case lies on the office floor. The culprit carries a map case over their shoulder.
The watchman saw a figure at the back door with a flat leather bag at their side. The culprit carries a leather map case.

habits.label: Medal ribbons
clues: A ribbon bar from the Medal for Courage was found on the rug in the owner's study. The culprit wears medal ribbons.
The apprentice remembers coloured ribbon stripes flashing on a lapel by the display case. The culprit wears medal ribbons.

habits.label: Grey streak
habits.habit: A grey streak in dark hair
clues: The watchman saw a head with a white streak over the forehead in the window of the gem store. The culprit has a grey streak.
A long white hair is caught on the velvet ring cushion in the showroom, and the sales staff are all young and dark-haired. The culprit has a grey streak.

habits.label: Tea from a saucer
clues: There's a saucer with the dregs of tea on the workbench, and the glass beside it is dry. The culprit drinks tea from the saucer.
The office cleaner says that an hour before it happened someone asked for hot tea and a deeper saucer. The culprit drinks tea from the saucer.

habits.label: Draws well
clues: The blotter in the owner's study has an accurate sketch of the necklace, drawn from memory. The culprit draws well.
On the back of a price tag in the showroom there's a quick pencil portrait of master Eidelman. The culprit can draw.

habits.label: Writes shorthand
clues: A page torn from the office calendar is covered in shorthand squiggles. The culprit writes shorthand.
Under the workshop table there's a scrap of notebook: a conversation with the master taken down in shorthand. The culprit knows shorthand.

habits.label: Amber prayer beads
habits.habit: Fingers a string of amber beads
clues: Three amber beads have rolled across the floor of the gem store, and there's no amber in the house. The culprit fingers amber prayer beads.
In the dark by the back door the watchman heard the dry click of beads. The culprit fingers prayer beads.

habits.label: Checked scarf
clues: A scrap of checked silk hangs on a nail by the back door. The culprit wears a checked neck scarf.
The regular customer remembers a small-check neck scarf by the display case. The culprit wears a checked scarf.

habits.label: Smells of the stables
clues: A straw and the heavy smell of horse sweat were left on a chair in the office. The culprit's clothes smell of the stables.
There's dry straw and a smear of manure from a boot sole on the clean floor of the gem store. The culprit smells of the stables.

habits.label: Birthmark
habits.habit: A dark birthmark on the cheek
clues: The courier bumped into someone with a dark birthmark on their cheek in the back doorway. The culprit has a birthmark on their cheek.
Through the crack in the workshop door the apprentice only saw a profile with a dark mark on the cheek. The culprit has a birthmark.

habits.label: Trophy fountain pen
habits.habit: A captured German fountain pen with a gold nib
clues: A design left in the office has a blot of green ink in the margin, the kind used in captured German pens. The culprit has a trophy fountain pen.
A pen cap with a German maker's mark was found under the safe in the strongroom. The culprit has a trophy fountain pen.

habits.label: Cracks sunflower seeds
clues: There's a little heap of sunflower seed husks by the back door. The culprit cracks sunflower seeds.
There are seed husks on the windowsill of the gem store, which is swept twice a day. The culprit cracks sunflower seeds.

habits.label: Keeps pigeons
clues: The watchman saw a grey pigeon with a ring on its leg take off from the back door. The culprit keeps pigeons.
There's a grey pigeon feather and some millet spilled from a pocket on the office windowsill. The culprit keeps pigeons.

tools: The fittings of the showroom case were taken off with a screwdriver without a single scratch on the brass. The culprit is handy with tools.
The box of samples in the workshop was opened with a fine needle file, and the lock is intact. The culprit is handy with tools.
glasses: A thin wire frame missing one lens lies on the floor by the strongroom door. The culprit wears glasses.
There are two round lens marks on the display glass, as if someone leaned right up against it. The culprit wears glasses.
cash: The day's takings are gone from the showroom till, and the book is neatly marked "handed in". The culprit had access to money.
According to the office receipts book, an order that never existed was paid this morning, and the money has vanished. The culprit had access to money.
safe: The strongroom door is wide open, the necklace designs are gone, and there isn't a scratch on the dial. The culprit knows the safe combination.
The small safe in the owner's study was opened on the first try; the watchman heard just one click. The culprit knows the safe combination.
keys: The display case was opened with its own key, and the lock is intact. The culprit had keys.
The gem store is double-locked from the outside, yet there are fresh footprints inside. The culprit had keys.
sched: The master was killed in the twenty minutes when the watchman makes his scheduled round of the yard. The culprit knows the schedule.
The strongroom was opened right after the evening cash hand-in, while the guards were changing. The culprit knows the schedule.
driver: There's a fresh van tyre track in the mud by the back door, though the courier didn't take the van that day. The culprit can drive.
The owner's car in the lane behind the office has been moved, and the engine is still warm. The culprit can drive.
passages: The footprints leave the workshop through a cellar door only insiders know about. The culprit knows the service passages.
There's a narrow gap behind the shelves between the gem store and the office, and the dust in it has been rubbed off. The culprit knows the service passages.
french: On the back of a design in the workshop there's a note: "collier, platine, 38 carats". The culprit knows French.
A Paris catalogue lies open in the owner's study, the necklace page folded down and the margins covered in French. The culprit knows French.
tech: The alarm in the strongroom has been disabled, its wires shorted. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
The electric bell at the back door was taken apart and put back together so it stays silent. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
perfume: The workshop smells of acid and metal, yet a sweet heavy perfume hangs in the air. The culprit wears heavy perfume.
The velvet cushion on the showroom counter smells of a thick evening perfume. The culprit wears heavy perfume.
strong: The heavy fireproof cabinet in the office was pulled away from the wall. The culprit is physically strong.
Master Eidelman was a heavy man, but someone lifted him and sat him at his workbench. The culprit is physically strong.
quiet: The apprentice sat on the other side of the workshop wall and heard no footsteps and no creak of the door. The culprit moves silently.
Someone walked the length of the creaky gem-store floor, and the watchman behind the wall didn't wake up. The culprit moves silently.
